neighborhoods._comment: 2020 Neighborhood Tabulation Areas. Fetched once into neighborhoods.geojson; not refetched nightly.

transit._comment: Not wired in the MVP. GTFS join is designed in engineering.md.
transit.label: subway

ticketmaster._comment: Tier 3. Needs a key; not used in the MVP.

parks._comment: NYC Parks Properties -- authoritative polygons for every park property. The permitted-events feed names parks rather than giving coordinates, so this is what places those events. Fetched once; parks do not move.

geocoder._comment: NYC Planning Labs GeoSearch (Pelias). Keyless and public. Only used for street-shaped locations that no park name matches.
